en: A black and white postcard image showing a large Baroque castle with a round tower topped by a dome and a spire in the background. There is a detailed stone bridge with ornate statues, including one of a person with a feathered hat in the foreground. The scene includes manicured gardens and a large conifer tree. The German text 'Barockschloß Moritzburg bei Dresden' appears at the bottom.
